Transcendence.description: Gain 5 Ability Haste at level 1 and another 5 at level 5. At level 9, after a basic ability hits a target, reduce 8% of that ability's cooldown (8s cooldown).

Eyeball Collector.description: Gain 1.5 Attack Damage or 3 Ability Power after scoring a champion or epic monster takedown, stacking up to 8 times (12 Attack Damage or 24 Ability Power maximum).
